description: Search GBIF occurrence records with Darwin Core filters. Use taxonKey from gbif_match_species for reliable results — a key names exactly one taxon, where a scientificName shared across kingdoms matches nothing; a Catalogue of Life key goes in checklistTaxonKey with checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b. Accepts country (uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, where the record was observed), publishingCountry (the publishing organization's country — a different question), stateProvince, gadmGid (a GADM administrative-area code GBIF derives from coordinates), bounding box (decimalLatitude/decimalLongitude ranges), WKT polygon geometry, year range, month, basis of record, coordinate filter, hasGeospatialIssue, dataset key, publishingOrg (the publishing organization), catalogNumber, institutionCode, recordedBy (collector), mediaType, typeStatus, establishmentMeans, and license. Rows carry no media unless includeMedia is set. Returns sightings only by default — GBIF also indexes absence records (surveys that looked and found nothing), and occurrenceStatus controls whether they are included. Pagination is capped at offset+limit=100,001 and GBIF offers no cursor or scroll, so a larger result set is covered only by partitioning it — facet it by DATASET_KEY with gbif_occurrence_facets and search each datasetKey separately. BASIS_OF_RECORD and PUBLISHING_COUNTRY are gap-free second cuts for a dataset bucket still over the cap; YEAR, MONTH, STATE_PROVINCE, and SPECIES_KEY lose records lacking that dimension. Repeat every biological filter on the facet call and each partition search, including the same occurrenceStatus, and compare sub-split sums against the bucket total. Bulk retrieval is outside this server: use the asynchronous GBIF Download API with a GBIF.org account or the monthly GBIF Parquet snapshot on AWS Open Data.

basisOfRecord.description: Filter by how the occurrence was recorded. HUMAN_OBSERVATION covers citizen science. PRESERVED_SPECIMEN covers natural history collections.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number a collection assigned to the specimen or record (e.g. "L.1592880"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively. Not unique across collections — one number can name records in several datasets, so pair it with institutionCode or datasetKey to single one out. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

checklistKey.description: Taxonomy taxon keys are read in, both in this scope and in KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY facet buckets. Omitted, or d7dddbf4-2cf0-4f39-9b2a-bb099caae36c, is the GBIF Backbone, whose integer keys taxonKey takes; GBIF no longer updates it. 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b is the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release, the taxonomy GBIF now maintains: scope by one of its keys with checklistTaxonKey, which requires this value, and taxonKey is rejected under it. Records keep their Backbone taxonKey either way.

checklistTaxonKey.description: Catalogue of Life taxon key, such as 3WSJV (Lynx pardinus), to scope to that taxon and every descendant — the checklistTaxonKey gbif_match_species or gbif_bulk_match_species returns under the same checklistKey, or a KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY bucket of gbif_occurrence_facets under it. Requires checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b, and goes to GBIF as its taxonKey. Uppercase letters and digits only, matched case-sensitively; a digit-only key such as 8288 (the genus Tringa) is not the Backbone taxonKey of the same spelling, which names an unrelated taxon. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty in meters as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive, where "*" may stand for one open end: "0,1000" or "*,1000" keeps records placed to within 1 km. A value without a comma is not an upper bound: GBIF matches only records whose uncertainty is exactly that value, so "1000" is not "within 1 km". Omit the field to accept any uncertainty — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of where the occurrence was recorded (e.g., "GB", "US", "DE", "SE"). Not the publisher's country — that is publishingCountry, and the two disagree on most records. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("gb", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here. Take a value from a COUNTRY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets; an uppercase pair GBIF does not know ("XX") is rejected upstream by name.

datasetKey.description: Restrict results to a single dataset by its GBIF dataset UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Obtain one from gbif_search_datasets, gbif_get_dataset, a DATASET_KEY facet (gbif_occurrence_facets), or the datasetKey field on an occurrence record. Omit the field to search every dataset — an empty string is rejected rather than read as no filter, because GBIF answers a blank datasetKey with the unfiltered result set.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84) as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive (e.g. "47.0,48.5"); pair it with a decimalLongitude range for a bounding box. A value without a comma is not a range: GBIF matches only records at exactly that latitude, so "38" is not "around 38". All supplied spatial filters intersect, geometry included. Omit the field to leave latitude unbounded — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84) as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive (e.g. "8.0,9.5"); pair it with a decimalLatitude range for a bounding box. A value without a comma is not a range: GBIF matches only records at exactly that longitude, so "-3" is not "around -3". All supplied spatial filters intersect, geometry included. Omit the field to leave longitude unbounded — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

establishmentMeans.description: How the organism came to be where it was recorded — a concept from GBIF's EstablishmentMeans vocabulary: native, nativeEndemic, nativeReintroduced, introduced, introducedAssistedColonisation, uncertain, or vagrant. Matched ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, then sent and echoed in scope in GBIF's own spelling; any other value is rejected. A concept also matches its narrower ones: native covers nativeEndemic and nativeReintroduced, and introduced covers introducedAssistedColonisation. Most records state none and match no value. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

gadmGid.description: GADM administrative-area GID at any level: country (ESP), state or province (ESP.1_1), county or district (ESP.1.5_1), or municipality (ESP.1.6.3_1). GBIF derives a record's GIDs from its coordinates, so records without coordinates match none, and the unit can differ from the verbatim stateProvince the record carries. Matched exactly and case-sensitively, and a GID holds only uppercase letters, digits, dots, and underscores — any other character is rejected. Take one from a GADM_LEVEL_0_GID, GADM_LEVEL_1_GID, GADM_LEVEL_2_GID, or GADM_LEVEL_3_GID facet on gbif_occurrence_facets, or from the gadm field of gbif_get_occurrence; a well-formed GID GBIF does not hold matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

geometry.description: WKT polygon for geographic filtering (e.g., POLYGON((8 47, 9 47, 9 48, 8 48, 8 47))). Coordinates are longitude latitude. All supplied spatial filters intersect: decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude remain active and restrict results to the overlap. Omit the field to search everywhere — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered result set.

hasCoordinate.description: When true, return only georeferenced records (those with coordinates). When false, return ONLY records without coordinates. Omit the parameter entirely to include all records regardless of coordinate presence.

hasGeospatialIssue.description: True keeps only records GBIF flagged with a spatial issue when interpreting them — zero coordinates, coordinates out of range, or coordinates outside the stated country, for example; false keeps only records with no such flag. GBIF often drops the coordinates of a flagged record, and a record without coordinates can carry either value, so for records to map pair false with hasCoordinate true. Omit for both.

includeMedia.description: Add each record's media items to its row as media — type, identifier URL, license, and rightsHolder for each, in the record's own order. Every item on a matched record is returned, whatever mediaType selected: that filter picks records carrying the type, not items. Off by default because each item adds to both response surfaces; gbif_get_occurrence returns one record's media with title and format.

institutionCode.description: Code of the institution holding the record (e.g. "K", "CLO"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively — part of a code or of a multi-word code matches nothing. An INSTITUTION_CODE facet on gbif_occurrence_facets lists the codes in a scope, lowercased, and this filter takes them unchanged. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

isInCluster.description: Filter to records flagged as likely duplicates (true) or exclude them (false). Omit to include all. Note: GBIF does not expose a cluster identifier — only the membership flag. To de-duplicate, set isInCluster: false to exclude all clustered records.

iucnRedListCategory.description: Restrict to records whose taxon carries this IUCN Red List category: CR Critically Endangered, EN Endangered, VU Vulnerable, NT Near Threatened, LC Least Concern, DD Data Deficient, EX Extinct, EW Extinct in the Wild, CD Conservation Dependent. Records with no category are excluded when this is set.

license.description: License the record is published under, as its GBIF code: CC0_1_0, CC_BY_4_0, or CC_BY_NC_4_0 — every record carries one of the three. A record states its license as a Creative Commons URL instead (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode for CC_BY_4_0), which this filter does not take.

limit.description: Number of records to return (default 20, max 300).

mediaType.description: Only records carrying at least one media item of this type: StillImage (photographs, scans), MovingImage (video), Sound (audio), or InteractiveResource. Records without media are excluded when this is set.

month.description: Calendar month (1–12). Useful for seasonal distribution queries.

occurrenceStatus.description: Presence/absence filter. Defaults to PRESENT: an ABSENT record documents a survey that looked for the taxon and did not find it, so including one would read as a sighting of the opposite. Use ANY for both (GBIF's own default), or ABSENT for non-observations alone. DETECTED and NOT_DETECTED, the spelling records and OCCURRENCE_STATUS facet buckets carry, select the same records as PRESENT and ABSENT and are sent as given.

offset.description: Pagination offset. GBIF serves offset+limit up to 100,001 and rejects anything past it, with no cursor or scroll to continue from. To reach a result set larger than that, split it into per-datasetKey searches using a DATASET_KEY facet from gbif_occurrence_facets — gap-free and high-cardinality, unlike YEAR, which leaves undated records in no bucket — rather than paging deeper.

publishingCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of the organization that published the record — distinct from where the occurrence was observed, which is country. Take a value from a PUBLISHING_COUNTRY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("us", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here.

publishingOrg.description: UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex) of the GBIF organization that published the records, to scope to what it shares across all its datasets — not the organization whose installation hosts them, and not publishingCountry. Take one from gbif_search_publishers, the publishingOrganizationKey of gbif_get_dataset, a gbif_search_datasets row, gbif_get_occurrence, or a gbif_search_occurrences row, or a PUBLISHING_ORG facet on gbif_occurrence_facets; a well-formed key GBIF does not hold matches zero records. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — an empty string is rejected rather than read as no filter, because GBIF answers a blank publishingOrg with the unfiltered scope.

recordedBy.description: Collector or observer, matched against each name in the record's recordedBy list (GBIF splits it on "|") exactly and case-sensitively: "Charles Darwin" and "charles darwin" differ, and one person written two ways ("Charles Darwin", "Darwin, C.") is two values. Take a value from a RECORDED_BY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets scoped the same way and pass it back unchanged; an unmatched value matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

scientificName.description: Scientific name filter, which GBIF resolves to its accepted taxon, so a synonym returns the records of that taxon. Less precise than taxonKey: a name shared across kingdoms, such as Oenanthe (a bird genus and a plant genus), matches nothing, so use taxonKey from gbif_match_species with kingdom set for one. Supplying both does not narrow the search: GBIF combines the two taxon filters with OR, so the result is the union of the two, not their intersection. Omit the field to search every name — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered result set.

stateProvince.description: State, province, or first-level administrative division, matched as a verbatim string — exact and case-sensitive. GBIF stores what each dataset recorded without normalizing it, so there is no vocabulary to guess from: "England", "England - Greater London", and "Greater London" are three distinct values, and "england" is none of them. Take one from a STATE_PROVINCE facet on gbif_occurrence_facets scoped the same way and pass it back unchanged — an unmatched value returns zero records rather than an error. Omit the field to search every state or province — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered result set. Records carrying no stateProvince match no value, so this cannot partition a scope.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key from gbif_match_species. Preferred over scientificName — a key names exactly one taxon, where a name can be shared across kingdoms. Matches the given taxon and all descendant taxa (subspecies, varieties, etc.). Rejected under checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b — pass a Catalogue of Life key as checklistTaxonKey there.

typeStatus.description: Nomenclatural type status of a specimen — a concept from GBIF's TypeStatus vocabulary such as Holotype, Isotype, Lectotype, Paratype, Syntype, Neotype, Type, or NotAType. Matched ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, then sent and echoed in scope in GBIF's own spelling; a value naming no concept is rejected with the full list. A concept also matches every narrower one — Type covers every kind of type, Lectotype covers Isolectotype — and a TYPE_STATUS facet on gbif_occurrence_facets lists the concepts in a scope. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

year.description: Year or year range. Single year: "2024". Range: "2020,2024". Filters by observation year. Both endpoints inclusive. Omit the field to search every year — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered result set.

name: gbif_search_occurrences

endOfRecords.description: True when there are no more results after this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `pagination_cap_exceeded`: offset + limit exceeds 100,001, the deepest page GBIF serves. `invalid_filter`: A filter value is unusable — a string filter other than country and publishingCountry supplied blank or whitespace-only (a blank country or publishingCountry fails earlier, at its uppercase pattern, as -32602 invalid_arguments), a bare "*" as decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, or coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, a datasetKey or publishingOrg that is not an 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID, a gadmGid holding a character other than an uppercase letter, digit, dot, or underscore, a checklistTaxonKey holding a character other than an uppercase letter or digit, a taxonKey under checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b or a checklistTaxonKey without it, a typeStatus or establishmentMeans naming no concept in its GBIF vocabulary, a two-letter country or publishingCountry code GBIF does not know, or a WKT geometry or range GBIF rejects. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, paging overshot, a read limit was clamped, a scientificName or an exact-match stateProvince, gadmGid, or recordedBy filter matched nothing, a decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, or coordinateUncertaintyInMeters without a comma matched only that exact value, the match is larger than the pagination cap can reach, or a presence/absence filter narrowed the result. Absent only when none applies.

occurrenceStatus.description: The presence/absence filter applied upstream, as sent — PRESENT or DETECTED for sightings, ABSENT or NOT_DETECTED for absences, or ANY when no filter was sent. Says what totalCount and the returned records cover.

items.description: A single occurrence record with location, taxon, date, and provenance fields.

acceptedScientificName.description: Scientific name of the accepted taxon as GBIF writes it, with authorship where GBIF has one (e.g. "Quercus castanea Née") — the accepted counterpart of scientificName. May be absent.

acceptedTaxonKey.description: Backbone taxon key of the accepted taxon. Equals taxonKey for a record filed under an accepted name; when taxonomicStatus is SYNONYM, taxonKey is the synonym and this is the taxon it resolves to. Passed as taxonKey, it covers the accepted taxon and every synonym. May be absent.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number the holding collection assigned — the value the catalogNumber filter matches. May be absent.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters. May be absent.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. May be absent.

datasetName.description: Name of the source dataset. May be absent.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). May be absent.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). May be absent.

depth.description: Depth in meters below the local surface, such as a water surface. May be absent.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level. May be absent.

establishmentMeans.description: How the organism came to be at the location (e.g. native, introduced), as the GBIF concept name the establishmentMeans filter takes unchanged. May be absent.

eventDate.description: Observation date as ISO 8601 string. May be absent.

eventTime.description: Time of day of the observation, with seconds and UTC offset (e.g. 20:15:00+01:00) — the offset eventDate omits when it carries a local time. May be absent.

individualCount.description: Number of individuals. May be absent.

institutionCode.description: Code of the institution holding the record — the value the institutionCode filter matches. May be absent.

issues.description: GBIF data quality issue flags for this record.

iucnRedListCategory.description: IUCN Red List category of the taxon — CR, EN, VU, NT, LC, DD, EX, EW, or CD. May be absent.

key.description: GBIF occurrence key for gbif_get_occurrence chaining.

license.description: License the record is published under, as the Creative Commons URL GBIF stores (e.g. http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode). The license filter takes the matching code instead — CC0_1_0, CC_BY_4_0, or CC_BY_NC_4_0 — not this URL. May be absent.

media.description: Every media item on the record, in the record's order, whatever mediaType selected. Present only when includeMedia is true and the record has media.

items.description: A media item (image, sound, video) attached to the record.

identifier.description: URL of the media file. May be absent.

license.description: License of the item as its source states it — a URL or free text, which can differ from the record's license. May be absent.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder to credit for the item. May be absent.

type.description: Media type (StillImage, Sound, MovingImage, …). May be absent.

occurrenceStatus.description: Whether the record asserts presence or absence: DETECTED when the taxon was there, NOT_DETECTED when it documents a survey that looked and did not find it. GBIF serves these spellings; the occurrenceStatus filter also takes the older PRESENT and ABSENT, which select the same records. A NOT_DETECTED record is not a sighting. May be absent.

publishingCountry.description: Country code of the publishing organization.

publishingOrganizationKey.description: UUID of the organization that published the record — GBIF's publishingOrgKey. Pass it as publishingOrg to the occurrence tools or gbif_search_datasets. May be absent.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the identified taxon.

recordNumber.description: Number the collector assigned when collecting (e.g. "JL 157") — how herbarium specimens are cited, beside recordedBy. Not the catalogNumber. May be absent.

rightsHolder.description: Person or organization that owns or manages rights over the record — the name to credit under a CC BY license. May be absent.

stateProvince.description: State or province name. May be absent.

taxonKey.description: Backbone taxon key — also when checklistKey scoped the search by a Catalogue of Life key.

taxonomicStatus.description: Status of the identification carried on this record — ACCEPTED, PROVISIONALLY_ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, DOUBTFUL, and so on. Says whether the occurrence was filed under an accepted name or a synonym. May be absent.

typeStatus.description: Nomenclatural type status of the specimen (e.g. Holotype, Isolectotype), as the GBIF concept name the typeStatus filter takes unchanged. May be absent.

scope.description: Effective supplied biological filters, with occurrenceStatus always included; excludes pagination and facet controls.

title: Search Occurrences
